gloss_en: The Name of the Holy One, blessed be He (שְׁמוֹ שֶׁל הַקָּדוֹשׁ־בָּרוּךְ־הוּא) — God's Name conceived as the vessel that bounds and contains the divine life-force from the Life of all life; in Likutey Moharan I:56 identified with the Torah, whose letters, words, verses, and sections function as measures (midot) delimiting that life-force
